title: Self-introduction
description: Introduce yourself to two interviewers, then expand on one detail you mentioned.

userInputs.label: What do you study or work in?

brief.scene: You have just walked into an interview room and sat down. Two interviewers are opposite you. Nothing has been said yet.
brief.yourGoal: Introduce yourself in under two minutes.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Greet the candidate and ask them to introduce themselves in under two minutes. One or two sentences only. Do not ask anything else.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Pick ONE specific thing the candidate mentioned and ask them to expand on it. Reference their exact words. One question only.

judged.label: Structure
judged.criterion: The introduction covers, in order: who they are, what they do, one specific concrete detail (a project, a result, an interest), and closes cleanly rather than trailing off.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Finish between 45 seconds and 2 min 10 sec
Cover who you are, what you do, one specific detail, and close cleanly
